title: FIPS probe: no comment explaining why separate fd instead of g_crypto2dev_fd
description: wc_crypto2dev_init (port.c:1386-1400) opens fips_probe_fd, issues CRYPTO2DEV_IOC_REQUIRE_FIPS, closes it. There is no comment explaining why g_crypto2dev_fd is not used directly. A future maintainer will see the extra open/close and 'simplify' it to issue the ioctl on g_crypto2dev_fd. If REQUIRE_FIPS has fd-level side effects, this simplification would be wrong. Needs: one-line comment stating the reason (e.g., 'REQUIRE_FIPS locks the fd to FIPS mode; use a probe fd to avoid locking the global fd' OR 'REQUIRE_FIPS is query-only; TODO: simplify to use g_crypto2dev_fd').
